parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment is a clarification question: "Why the generated images of Figure 4 (a) shows only one of the [18],[19] for each input image?" This does not explicitly state an action; it is phrased as a question. However, an action can be inferred: the authors should address why only one of the two references is shown. The comment points to a specific figure and references, so the authors can deduce the general issue that needs to be addressed. The action is implicit, but the implementation is vague: the comment gives no guidance on how to resolve the issue — the authors could explain it in text, add missing results from both [18] and [19], or revise the figure, and the comment does not indicate which is appropriate. Since the comment only implicitly suggests an action and lacks detail on how to apply it, it matches the rubric description of an implicitly stated action that is vague rather than an implicit action with concrete implementation details.
